verifications.claim: HBO is developing a new Harry Potter live-action television series.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: HBO reboot (R1); HBO Original Harry Potter series (R2); HBO’s Harry Potter TV series (R3); HBO’s new Harry Potter series (R4); TV series based on J.K. Rowling's “Harry Potter” books is set to debut on HBO (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm HBO is producing a new live-action Harry Potter TV series.

verifications.claim: The Harry Potter live-action television series is set to premiere around Christmas 2026 or 2027.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: Christmas 2026 (R1, R3, R4); debut in 2027 (R2); Christmas 2026 — earlier than the 2027 date previously announced (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources provide conflicting premiere dates (2026 vs. 2027), making the claim's hedging accurate but sources contradictory.

verifications.claim: The first season of the Harry Potter television series is anticipated for Christmas 2026 or 2027.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: first series will launch in Christmas 2026 (R1); debut in 2027 (R2); Christmas 2026 (R3); December 25, 2026 (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on exact date for first season (2026 vs. 2027).

verifications.claim: The Harry Potter television series will be a decade-long adaptation of J.K. Rowling’s seven books.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: entire production is expected to take 10 years... cover each of Rowling's seven books (R1); 10-year long process... adapt each of the seven beloved books (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches descriptions of 10-year adaptation of seven books.

verifications.claim: Each season of the Harry Potter television series will cover one novel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: film a series to cover each of Rowling's seven books (R1); adapt each of the seven beloved books into its own season (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states one season per book.

verifications.claim: The Harry Potter television series will feature an entirely new cast.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: new cast (R5); Warwick Davis is reprising his role as Professor Filius Flitwick (R1, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe new cast for leads but note reprises (e.g., Warwick Davis), contradicting 'entirely new'.

verifications.claim: The Harry Potter television series is designed for the Max streaming service.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: HBO Max (R1); HBO Max where it’s available (R2); HBO Max, which was later renamed Max (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly confirms streaming on Max (formerly HBO Max).

verifications.claim: Francesca Gardiner (Succession) will be the showrunner.

verifications.evidence: written and executive produced by Francesca Gardiner (R2); Succession writer Francesca Gardiner serves as showrunner (R3); Francesca Gardiner, known for... Succession, will serve as the showrunner (R4); Francesca Gardiner ("Succession") will serve as showrunner (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly name her as showrunner with Succession credit.

verifications.claim: Mark Mylod (Game of Thrones) will direct multiple episodes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Mark Mylod will executive produce and direct multiple episodes (R2); Game of Thrones veteran Mark Mylod directs several episodes (R3); Game of Thrones and Succession vet Mark Mylod will... direct multiple episodes (R4); Mark Mylod ("Game of Thrones") is set to direct multiple episodes (R5)
